{{Quote|We must surprise the Empire by doing what they least expect: a frontal assault on their homeworld. Jedi and Republic warships will converge on Dromund Kaas and engage the Imperial fleet. We will mask your assault on the surface.|Jedi Grandmaster Satele Shan coordinates an assault on Dromund Kaas with the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Mutual Assured Destruction">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Mutual Assured Destruction|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>}}
The '''First Defense Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] charged with defending [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Doomsday" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the fleet battled the forces of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] when an invasion force under the leadership of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] [[Dromund Kaas operation|attacked]] Dromund Kaas. The Defense Fleet was largely successful during the battle, inflicting heavy casualties on the enemy, but the Republic fleet withdrew when their true mission&mdash;[[Dromund Kaas operation|the defeat]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]&mdash;was completed.<ref name="Doomsday" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The planet's formidable defenses include orbital battle stations, ground-to-space artillery and the First Defense Fleet.|The planet's summary for Dromund Kaas|<ref name="Doomsday" />}}
The First Defense Fleet was first mentioned in the planet's summary for Dromund Kaas during "Doomsday", a story mission for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Doomsday" />
